reuse.why: The actions reuse category selection, amount conversion, batching and undo helpers, but isFixedGroup reimplements tag recognition already provided by shared/tags.ts.

duplication.why: Eligibility rules remain centralized, but the new fixed-group regex duplicates existing shared tag-recognition logic.

placement.why: Budget eligibility belongs in budget/actions.ts and handler registration follows existing layering, but tag syntax should remain in shared/tags.ts.

scope.why: The changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, focused tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared predicate and argument type keep the actions straightforward to maintain, with independent tag parsing the main design concern.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: isFixedGroup uses its own regex instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: isFixedGroup reshapes existing shared tag-recognition logic into a specialized boolean regex check.

abstraction_drift.where: All month-wide actions continue through the existing shared category predicate; the added exclusions apply uniformly, and no consumer-specific parameters or branches are added to that abstraction.
